爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD049 风间红叶Kazama Momiji-共舞时裙摆荡漾
舞池中他搂紧她的腰，掌心温度透过薄纱。
“总裁…”话音未落，他带着她转了个圈，“别叫职称，叫我的名字。”
露台阴影里，他忽然将她轻轻抵在墙边。
“穿这样来，是想让我分心？
她踮脚替他整理：“你领结歪了。”
香水味萦绕間他已經吻上她的嘴唇。
胸型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD049 Kazama Momiji-Her skirt swayed as they danced
On the dance floor, he tightened his grip on her waist, the warmth of his palm seeping through the thin fabric.
"President..." Before she could finish speaking, he spun her around, "Don't call me by my title, call me by my name."
In the shadows of the terrace, he suddenly and gently pressed her against the wall.
"Dressed like this, trying to distract me?"
She tiptoed to straighten his tie: "Your bow tie is crooked."
Amidst the lingering scent of perfume, he kissed her lips.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
